integrity: Analytic derivation and exact rational finite checks are supplied. Numerical checks do not establish the infinite claims. Sources are cited at their verified first public dates and independent scientific validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Four participating cells strictly positive; fixed cell probabilities as sample size increases; disjoint uncentered absolute contrasts only. The general-reference centered statistic, adjacent edges, and critical shrinking-imbalance windows are not covered. Possible equivalent results implicit in general negative-dependence or folded-moment theory have not been excluded independently.
title: Strictly negative disjoint histogram-edge covariance and its three scaling phases
